_comment: Copy this file to 'song_overrides.json' to correct song metadata.
The importer guesses artist and title from the filename, assuming the
pattern 'Artist - Title.mp3'. When a file is named the other way around
('Title - Artist.mp3') there is no way to tell which half is which, so
The key is the audio filename exactly as it appears in data/library/audio/
or data/samples/audio/. Any of 'artist', 'title' and 'language' may be set;
anything you leave out keeps the value guessed from the filename.
These corrections are reapplied on every import, so they survive running
'sync_locked': true protects a song from automatic word sync completely:
it is never queued, never re-run, gets no draft, and its lyric files are
never written by auto sync. Use it for songs you timed carefully by hand.
The manual sync editor still works on a locked song.
Keys starting with an underscore, like this one, are ignored.
